title: Round 25 CI actual consumption audit (final checkpoint)

scope.included: All evidence/round25/dispatch-*.json and the unique matching raw ci-run.json under evidence/round25/<run_id>/**; per-job records and step conclusions embedded in ci-run.json; K failed-setup receipt and log.
scope.excluded: No network/API polling, no new CI, no billing estimate, no benchmark JSONL/artifact duplication accounting, no authorized timeout projection, no private material.
scope.counting_rule: Per run, include only non-skipped job rows with raw startedAt and completedAt. Actual elapsed is the difference of these two source timestamps. Queue is raw ci-run.createdAt to the earliest included job.startedAt. Skipped jobs are excluded even if their raw interval is negative.
scope.timeout_rule: job_timeout_minutes is recorded per run for context only and is never counted as actual consumption.

wall_definitions.sum_actual_job_wall_seconds: Sum of per-run elapsed wall time for included non-skipped job rows; includes setup/checkout/job overhead, and is not candidate-only CPU time.
wall_definitions.runner_cumulative_seconds: Sum of actual non-skipped job elapsed time across all runs; equal to the above here because each run has exactly one non-skipped job row.
wall_definitions.global_observed_span: Difference between earliest raw actual-job start and latest raw actual-job completion; includes gaps/overlap and is not cloud consumption.

totals.absolute_UTC_alignment_certainty: VERIFIED for source-reported UTC consistency across the 34 raw dispatch and CI receipts: per-run dispatch/created/job-start offsets are coherent and the raw endpoint precedes the current tool UTC observation. This verifies the timestamp chain, not independent calibration of the provider clock.

timestamp_audit.finding: All raw source timestamps use explicit UTC markers and their per-run dispatch → CI-created → job-start order is consistent. The previous derived JSON endpoint fields are 28,800 seconds earlier than matching raw receipts; retract those derived endpoints. The transformation cause remains UNKNOWN, but this discrepancy is isolated to the prior derived report and is not evidence of an 8-hour error in the 34 raw dispatch/CI records.
timestamp_audit.source_reported_raw_timestamp_alignment: VERIFIED: all 34 dispatch_utc (+00:00), ci-run createdAt (Z) and first actual job startedAt (Z) are ordered consistently within each run; all dispatch→created and created→job offsets are nonnegative and bounded as reported. Latest job completion precedes the audit tool UTC clock by 923 seconds.
timestamp_audit.legacy_derived_endpoint_disposition: RETRACTED: the old checkpoint JSON normalized global endpoints are 8 hours earlier than matching raw receipt endpoints and must not be used as the current raw UTC boundaries. The raw dispatch/CI timestamp chain is internally consistent.
timestamp_audit.legacy_transformation_root_cause: UNKNOWN: the exact cause of the prior report conversion error was not independently established; no offset was applied to raw source strings.
